Lewis Hamilton won the most races at Silverstone between 2000 and 2025, with 9 wins.

His wins came in 2008, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2019, 2020, 2021 and 2024. The next most successful drivers had 2 wins each: Michael Schumacher, Fernando Alonso, Sebastian Vettel, Mark Webber and Max Verstappen. The count includes the 2020 70th Anniversary Grand Prix, which the circuit history lists separately from the British Grand Prix. Verstappen's 2020 win there is one of his two.

ANSWER: Lewis Hamilton
